reason: I already have my own bike and school is a 20-minute walk, so I'd never actually need to rent one. Paying even 5 € a month for something I already own makes no sense with my pocket money.
objection: I already have a bike that's free to ride, so why would I pay for one? And with only 10 bikes in town there probably wouldn't even be one near me.
would_change_my_mind: If my own bike broke or got stolen and I needed to get somewhere quickly, I might pay 1.50 € for a single ride.
